citations.assessment: Rabbi Acha the Great opens the homily on the promise to Abraham and the sending of the spies.
The precise Lia–Yosa–Acha Rabba chain occurs in the discussion of concentration in prayer. The byname matches the sense of great in Tanchuma, leaving personal identification open.

evidence.witness: The Jerusalem Talmud, edition by Heinrich W. Guggenheimer. Berlin, De Gruyter, 1999-2015
